subject: Cultural and Creative Arts
sourceFile: Copy of Cultural & Creative Arts BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: Cultural and Creative Arts covers Arts and Crafts and Performing Arts and Entertainment (Music, Drama and Dance); it assesses candidates' aesthetic development, visual and imaginative capabilities, exposure to African choreography, music and dancing styles, and potential in drama, costume making and make-up design. The examination has three papers of one hour each, together weighted 70%, plus 30% from school Continuous Assessment. Paper I: 60 multiple-choice questions (one mark each) on Art and Crafts. Paper II: 60 questions on Performing Arts and Entertainment — Music 30, Drama 20 and Dance 10. Paper III: a single 100-mark practical question on painting.
excluded: Left out the syllabus.ng "About Us", "About BECE", eligibility, grading, registration, table of contents and FAQ chapters (publisher marketing / general information, not syllabus content). Themes (Art and Crafts; Performing Art and Entertainment) and sub-themes are recorded in each topic's content rather than as topics.
